skill.name: wallet-lookup
skill.description: Use StalkChain to look up Solana or supported EVM wallets. Review holdings, trading performance, transaction history, and Hyperliquid positions where available.
skill.summary: Summarize public wallet holdings, performance, and activity with StalkChain.
skill.author: stalkc

security_audit.summary: All eleven static alerts are false positives: the backticks format Markdown, and the Hyperliquid lookup reads wallet positions rather than inspecting the host. The workflow can incur connector charges without an explicit budget or approval. Matching addresses and early transfers can also lead to unsupported attribution.

remediation.issue: Paid lookups can exceed the requested scope.
remediation.suggestion: Show the chains, calls, and estimated credits before expanding the lookup. Ask for approval before adding paid checks or exceeding the agreed budget.

remediation.issue: Address matches and early transfers can be mistaken for proof of ownership or funding.
remediation.suggestion: Identify accounts by chain and address. Label the earliest returned sender as a possible funding source and verify the claim before stating it as fact.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format the literal EVM address prefix in Markdown. They do not enclose an executable command.
The backticks label a StalkChain profit and loss tool and its arguments. The instruction calls the connector, not a shell interpreter.
The inline spans name a portfolio connector tool and its Solana chain argument. The wallet address is supplied as a tool argument, not interpolated into a shell command.
The spans document an EVM portfolio tool and its filters. No shell command or command substitution is shown.
The spans label a connector lookup for first transactions and lifetime wallet activity. The backticks are Markdown formatting, not execution syntax.
The spans label the transfers connector and its chain and sort parameters. The sort value changes transaction order, not shell behavior.
The backticks identify a StalkChain tool and its wallet argument. The operation reads Hyperliquid trading data through the connector.
The span names the tool that returns an interactive portfolio card. The terminal reference only describes how to present results without that card.
The span shows an abbreviated address as a display example. It is not an instruction to execute anything.
The span formats the missing-data marker. The rule only distinguishes missing values and unchecked chains from zero balances.
The lookup returns Hyperliquid account value, trading positions, and recent trades for the supplied wallet. It does not enumerate the local system, services, or network.

semantic_findings.title: Paid Lookups Without Explicit Budget Approval
semantic_findings.description: The EVM workflow defaults to a broad portfolio query and includes a separate age check billed per chain. It gives no approval step for that spend.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions state the credit prices and list both calls as default steps. No evidence found that the connector itself enforces a user-approved budget.

semantic_findings.title: Overstated Wallet Attribution
semantic_findings.description: The skill equates matching EVM addresses across chains and suggests that ascending transfer order shows who funded a wallet. Neither signal proves the claimed attribution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both statements are explicit. The warning against identity speculation helps, but the workflow still lacks verification for cross-chain ownership and funding claims.

content.user_title: Look Up Crypto Wallet Holdings and Activity
content.value_statement: Wallet data can be spread across networks, making holdings and activity hard to compare. Use StalkChain to summarize balances, trading performance, and activity for a public address.
actual_capabilities: Recognize Solana and EVM address formats.
Show Solana realized profit, unrealized profit, and win rate.
Summarize holdings and USD values on queried chains.
Report first transaction dates and lifetime activity for queried EVM chains.
Summarize recent or early EVM transfers on a selected chain.
Report Hyperliquid account value, open positions, and liquidation prices.
limitations: Lookups send the public wallet address to the StalkChain connector and use credits.
An EVM address does not identify which chain to query.
A missing value or failed chain does not indicate a zero balance.
A wallet address or early transfer alone cannot verify ownership or funding.

use_cases.title: Review Solana Trading Results
use_cases.description: Check realized and unrealized profit and win rate for a public Solana wallet.

use_cases.title: Summarize Treasury Holdings
use_cases.description: Compare USD values and leading holdings across selected EVM chains.

use_cases.title: Review Leveraged Exposure
use_cases.description: Inspect Hyperliquid long and short positions and their reported liquidation prices.

prompt_templates.title: Check Solana Performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review trading results for one wallet.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check realized profit, unrealized profit, and win rate for this public Solana wallet: [address]. Skip holdings and extra lookups.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Holdings by Chain
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare a wallet across two named chains.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [address] to compare holdings on Ethereum and Base only. Show the USD total and top holdings for each chain. Flag unchecked chains.

prompt_templates.title: Review Early Transfers
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Examine the first recorded activity on one chain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate the credits to check wallet age and early transfers for [address] on Base. Wait for approval. Describe early senders without assuming who funded the wallet.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Hyperliquid Exposure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review leveraged positions within a credit budget.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Hyperliquid positions for [address] within [credit budget]. Report open longs, shorts, liquidation prices, and monthly profit. Ask before making any extra calls.

output_examples.input: Example Solana wallet: Show trading performance without a holdings lookup.
output: Realized profit: $1,200. Unrealized loss: $150. Win rate: 58%.

output_examples.input: Example EVM wallet: Compare holdings on Ethereum and Base.
output: Ethereum: $8,400 in reported holdings, mostly ETH and USDC.
Base: The lookup failed. The balance is unknown.

output_examples.input: Example Hyperliquid wallet: Summarize open positions and monthly results.
output: Open positions: ETH long and BTC short.
Reported ETH liquidation price: $1,900. BTC liquidation price: unavailable.

best_practices: Name the chains and set a credit budget before requesting paid lookups.
Share only a public wallet address and ask for the metrics you need.
State which chains were checked and verify ownership or funding claims independently.
anti_patterns: Providing a seed phrase or private key for a public wallet lookup.
Treating unavailable balances or failed lookups as zero.
Treating an address match or the earliest returned transfer as proof of ownership or funding.

faq.question: Which wallets can I look up?
faq.answer: The skill handles Solana and supported EVM chains, including Ethereum and Base. Provide the chain when you know it.

faq.question: Do I need to connect my wallet?
faq.answer: No wallet connection or signature is needed. The lookup uses a public address and requires the StalkChain connector.

faq.question: Do lookups cost credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Cost depends on the tool, requested data, and chain count. Ask for an estimate before requesting several checks.

faq.question: Can the skill identify a wallet owner?
faq.answer: No. With a known trader handle, the separate trader-check skill can return addresses for comparison.

faq.question: What does a failed chain mean?
faq.answer: The chain was not checked successfully. Its holdings and balance are unknown, not zero.

faq.question: Can the skill show leveraged positions?
faq.answer: It can report Hyperliquid longs, shorts, and liquidation prices when available. It does not place trades.
